digest.component_or_area: Plan-review prompt caching and Pass-1/Pass-2 coordination
propositions: Anthropic cache breakpoint on whole system block prevents plan-bearing prefix reuse across Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier because their system prompts differ past the preamble; moving plan into verifier system prompt enables within-pass reuse across chunks and cross-run reuse within cache TTL.
Pass-1 and verifier prompts must share a byte-identical plan-bearing prefix emitted from a single code seam (prompts.shared_plan_prefix) to position them for provider-side prefix reuse without drift.
Every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF) requires an exhaustiveness directive stating findings must enumerate every independent defect in the current run without deferral.

Verifier system prompts must begin with {{shared_prefix}} variable and lose the {{plan}} variable and volatile marker; per-chunk finding listings remain in user turn via base_instructions/instructions.
Pass-1 warm gate must measure tokens of the actual shared prefix (preamble + plan) rather than plan alone, requiring a helper _prefix_tokens() that tests against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS.
plan-review_verify_inputs output must emit shared_prefix in place of plan, with schema updated to name shared_prefix and eliminate stale plan descriptions.
